ops.title: Engineer long-running action queries and package
ops.description: Extract action state and Book into a Python package. Add coherent indexed selected queries while preserving existing JSON writers and commands. Verify scaling, concurrency, ownership, isolated wheel and release/adoption. Prepare a safe later persistent-storage cutover.

ops.text: Paired CI proves 100 targeted Book queries decode and construct unchanged history once
Concurrent and in-place mutation, selected-copy isolation, ownership and existing tests pass
Built wheel runs isolated and old CLI entrypoint remains valid
Merged, released, installed and natural adoption verified under root grant
